observed_result: PipeWire native playback is the primary build falsifier because its stream API exposes deactivate, non-draining flush and timing/queue introspection; direct ALSA is a fallback whose cancellation primitive is snd_pcm_drop(), not snd_pcm_drain(). A monotonic playback_generation fence is required so late TTS/audio chunks from an interrupted utterance cannot re-enter playback or become spoken-history evidence.

current_f2_voice_contract.constraint: VoiceIntent/VoiceSessionCapsule/VoiceOutcome are causal identity contracts only; playback must remain subordinate evidence and must not mint memory/effect/completion authority.

next_exact_action: After consuming the T7-SYS-002 target hardware/audio inventory, implement or claim a nonduplicate Trigger-4 playback transport falsifier with exact voice_session binding, playback_generation cancellation fence, PipeWire deactivate+flush(false), ALSA drop fallback, deterministic stale-chunk rejection and loopback measurement of barge-in-detected to last audible old-generation sample.
